approach: Decompilation of the PS2 executable (matching if the original compiler is available), then a native PC port running the player's own copy of the game
notes: Works on the PS2 release (a separate Xbox 360 recomp exists: rbxrootx/samurai_warriors_2_empires_recomp). Just started: tools for the disc and the executable are in place; file formats and the compiler are the first steps. No game files in the repository.
